worldcombat.skill.metalsound.summary: Grind your own metal together to send a horrible high-pitched sound through cover and into a foe's ears, scraping its Sp. Def down one stage at a time. Pulling the sound out takes a long windup standing still; each scrape re-checks that the target is still in range; a long grind adds a stage and rings longer but is slower.
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.use.0: Grind a Sp. Def wall down stage by stage through cover
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.use.1: Scrape all the way down while a teammate tanks and the target cannot move
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.use.2: Start safely behind a wall, then send the sound through
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.description: The target is scraped down %1$s stages of Sp. Def in total, one scrape about every %3$s, and rings for about %2$s; while ringing, metal rings keep rippling on it and companions will not grind it again. Each stage is kept like any ordinary stat stage.
The sound reaches ears %1$s blocks away; cover does not stop it, and every scrape re-checks the target is still within that range - leaving it stops the remaining scrapes.
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.timing: Range %1$s blocks, telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
Off (quick scrape): faster to pull out and a shorter cooldown, with the base drop and resonance. On (long grind): you grind it out, resonance about x1.45, Sp. Def one stage lower, but +5 ticks of telegraph and +20 ticks of cooldown. Grinding longer presses deeper while you stand exposed.
Only consider the grind when a threat is within this distance; smaller stays close, larger chases first.
On: the companion will leave a hold position to deliver the metal sound.
